Online classes are flexible. ___, students can feel isolated.
Fuel prices rose. ___, more people started cycling.
___ tourism creates jobs, it can damage the environment.
Some countries, ___ Norway, have high taxes on cars.
The city built new bike lanes. This encouraged people to cycle.
Many students work part-time. This is why they have less time to study.

questions.questionText: Online classes are flexible. ___, students can feel isolated.
Fuel prices rose. ___, more people started cycling.
___ tourism creates jobs, it can damage the environment.
Some countries, ___ Norway, have high taxes on cars.
The city built new bike lanes, ______ encouraged people to cycle. (relativo)
Starting every sentence with a connector improves your Coherence and Cohesion score.

explanations.general: Falso: uso mecânico e excessivo reduz a nota.
